name: Systems by Vega
description: Systems by Vega is a B2B operations studio that gets small businesses off spreadsheets and onto custom databases, dashboards, and clean process — built solo, end to end, with real tools instead of an enterprise price tag. The site pairs a storefront with a live, interactive operations console demo, hosted on GitHub Pages with a GitHub-token-based admin for managing the portfolio without touching code.

name: Kingdom Creatives
description: Kingdom Creatives is a faith-driven digital studio that builds and manages church and ministry websites on a WordPress Multisite platform, using Elementor and a curated plugin stack for consistent, maintainable design. Clonable site templates and a built-in sponsorship program let new ministries launch a polished, full-featured web presence in a fraction of the usual time and cost.

name: YourLife CC
description: YourLife CC is a faith-and-family PWA that helps parents run their household — chores, allowance, life skills, and a Christian faith path — as an installable web app that works across devices. It's built on Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, and Brevo, with a Claude-powered Bible study hub, a PIN-gated admin dashboard, and a hardened security model developed across a multi-phase A+ roadmap.

name: YourLife CC — Faith Journey
tagline: A guided faith journey inside YourLife CC
description: The Faith Journey is a free, Duolingo-style discipleship path inside YourLife CC — a "My Walk with God" home that organizes, educates, and motivates believers without the $40–70/year price of apps like Hallow or Abide. It runs on the same Vercel + Supabase stack with a Claude API Bible study hub and OpenAI text-to-speech, deployed via git push and validated before every commit.

name: Return
description: The Return is a QR-code tote inventory system built for Celebration Church's men's retreat, letting volunteers scan any tote to see its supply list, track reorder thresholds, and manage chain-of-custody — all from a phone. It runs on Vercel + Supabase with a PIN-gated admin edge function, HMAC-signed sessions, and RLS lockdown, deployed as a single-file app at yourlifecc.com/return.

name: Legacy Vault
tagline: A secure vault for family legacy
description: Legacy Vault is the anchor feature of YourLife CC's Lifetime plan — a private, permanent place for parents to preserve letters, memories, and family legacy for their children to receive over time. Rather than a fragile standalone product, it's built into an app families already trust and use weekly, turning a "someday" idea into a reason to stay for life.

name: Estate Sale Biz
description: Estate Sale Biz is a web presence for an estate-sale operation, giving the business a professional online front for listings and client inquiries. Built and deployed as a lean static site under the Kingdom Creatives umbrella.

name: Dom Vegz
description: Dom Vegz is the official artist site for EDM producer and DJ Dom Vegz — releases, shows, videos, photos, and booking, in a bold single-page design. Deployed on GitHub Pages and moving to a Supabase-backed admin with PIN login and a real booking pipeline (stored and emailed via Resend), so the artist can manage his own content without touching code.

name: Operations Command Center
description: An interactive, fully genericized demo of the operations, analytics, and field-sales platforms I build for a national retail network — dashboards with live charts, a searchable/sortable sites database, an implementation task board, a vendor-ROI tracker, a partner-onboarding pipeline, a territory heatmap, a revenue calculator, and a training LMS. Every company, person, vendor, and metric is fictional sample data.

name: Site Shop
tagline: White-labeled small-business site templates, ready to launch
description: Nine ready-to-sell small-business websites — landscaping, pressure washing, detailing, personal training, BBQ, dumpster rental, tattoo, fabrication, and contracting — each with a signature interactive feature and an owner-editable live CMS. Browse the full gallery and click into any live demo.

name: Prime Bin Cleaning
description: Prime Bin Cleaning is the web presence and booking front for a teen-owned residential garbage-bin cleaning service in Idaho's Treasure Valley — power-washing, sanitizing, and deodorizing bins curbside. The single-page site handles the full pitch (pricing, process, before/after results) and a text-to-book flow, deployed as a lean static site under the Kingdom Creatives umbrella.
